descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S19 Course-refresh call time and which model wrote the entry

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U11 Each course-entry AI call records which model ran and its own call time separately from the total; runs over 30 s where the AI service was not the cause go to review (timings are targets, not Pass/Fa … (UAT 3.5; UAT 3.9)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given The 10 AI-check notes of S13 + S14, plus the end-to-end runs of S02 (Nursing Home) and S11 (Hospital)

When Each note is sent once through refreshCourseAndBackground; in S02 and S11 the time from the Generate tap to the entry is recorded

Then Every call leaves an aiCallLog row with the model, durationMs and providerMs; any fallback is recorded (fellBackFrom); calls over 30 s are listed for review. End to end: Hospital Generate → Post-Round visible, Nursing Home Generate → 'Encounter done' replaced by the entry, each paired with its refresh row

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Deterministic: one aiCallLog row per call with model + durationMs + providerMs (U11, 3.9). maxMs 30000 flags for review only (3.5: targets, not Pass/Fail). End to end (from S02/S11 timing blocks): from the start of the notes.generateNote row to the end of the notes.refreshCourseAndBackground row, shown next to that row's providerMs and durationMs so AI time and the rest can be …

Where it ran: local aicheck-other (AI output checks); test method PERF · Performance timing; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane aicheck-other.

Test method: PERF · Performance timing; secondary: CONFIG · Config check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: aicheck-other.

UAT item: TC-11 Course Timeline · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-11/S19

Course-refresh call time and which model wrote the entry

Tickets: none (UAT only)

New local lane aicheck-other: status passed in aicheck-other/results.json → passed (passed).

How it is tested (aicheck-other/plan.json, automatable: partly): Timing/model record of the same 10 S13+S14 refresh calls (no extra calls): one aiCallLog row per call with model + durationMs + providerMs; calls > 30 s flagged for review only. The end-to-end half (S02/S11 Generate tap to entry) belongs to those agent cases and is recorded as not covered here. — Direct-call half automated (reads the S13+S14 rows, no extra calls); the end-to-end tap-to-entry half needs the browser Generate run of S02/S11 and 'generate'. Reported as 'passed (direct-call half only)'.

Detail:

DIRECT-CALL HALF ONLY. The 10 S13+S14 refresh calls each left one notes.refreshCourseAndBackground aiCallLog row with model, durationMs and providerMs; all Haiku, no fallback; 3.2-4.6 s per call (providerMs 3.1-4.5 s, app overhead under 0.1 s); none over 30 s. The end-to-end half of the oracle (Generate tap -> Post-Round / 'Encounter done' replaced, paired with the refresh row, from S02/S11) is not covered here and needs Generate; this 'passed' does not cover it.

Scope (scope): passed (direct-call half only); end-to-end half not run

Evidence: 1 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B (course-entry-ai, not built): it times direct refreshCourseAndBackground calls; on dev the runner calls no action (runner-contract §10.2), so that half runs on the local stack only.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
